description: Returns one 4D operator's most recent official draw results (1st, 2nd, 3rd, special and consolation numbers), newest first. Official results only; no number recommendations or forecasts.

limit.description: How many recent draws to return (1-30, default 10).

operator.description: Operator id. One of: magnum, damacai, toto, sg, sabah88, stc, cashsweep, gd, perdana, 9lotto.

name: get_operator_results
title: One operator's recent 4D results
